auth_password_help: 15 characters minimum. A sentence works very well.
auth_password_compromised: This password appears in known data breaches, choose another one.
auth_password_check_unavailable: This password could not be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
auth_check_inbox_body: An email was just sent to {email}. Click the link it contains to continue: it is valid for 24 hours.
auth_link_resent: The link was just sent again.
auth_link_invalid_title: This link is no longer valid
auth_error: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
email_footer: Do not reply to this email.
email_verify_intro: Click this link to confirm your address and open your BattleCRM account. It is valid for 24 hours and works only once.
email_verify_ignore: If you did not ask for an account, ignore this email: no account will be created.
email_account_exists_intro: Someone, probably you, just asked for a BattleCRM account with this address. It already has one.
email_account_exists_reset: Forgot your password? Reset it here:
email_account_exists_ignore: If it was not you, there is nothing to do.
auth_link_invalid_body: It has expired or was already used.
auth_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes, or reset your password.
email_new_device_subject: New sign-in to your BattleCRM account
email_new_device_intro: Your account was just opened from a device that had never signed in to it:
email_new_device_not_me: If it was you, there is nothing to do. If not, choose a new password: all your devices will be signed out.
auth_forgot_password_body: Enter the address of your account to receive a reset link.
auth_forgot_password_sent: If an account exists for this address, a link was just sent.
account_password_body: Changing your password signs your other devices out.
account_password_changed: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.
account_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
email_password_reset_intro: Click this link to choose a new password. It is valid for 1 hour and works only once.
email_password_reset_ignore: If you did not ask for anything, ignore this email: your password does not change.
email_password_changed_intro: The password of your BattleCRM account was just changed. Your other devices were signed out.
email_password_changed_not_me: If it was you, there is nothing to do. If not, choose a new password right away.
email_change_confirm_intro: Click this link to use this address with your BattleCRM account. It is valid for 1 hour and works only once.
email_change_confirm_ignore: If you did not ask for anything, ignore this email: nothing changes.
email_change_notice_intro: A change of email address was just requested for your BattleCRM account, to {email}. It takes effect when the link sent to that address is clicked.
email_change_notice_not_me: If it was you, there is nothing to do. If not, choose a new password right away: the request will be cancelled.
account_email_body: The change takes effect when you click the link sent to the new address.
account_email_sent: A link was just sent to {email}. Your address will change when you click it: it is valid for 1 hour.
email_two_factor_enabled_intro: Two-factor authentication was just turned on for your BattleCRM account. A code will be asked at every sign-in.
email_two_factor_disabled_intro: Two-factor authentication was just turned off for your BattleCRM account. Your password alone signs you in again.
email_two_factor_not_me: If it was you, there is nothing to do. Otherwise, choose a new password right away.
auth_two_factor_body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
auth_two_factor_expired: Signing in took too long. Start again with your password.
auth_two_factor_reset_help: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
account_two_factor_off: A code from your authenticator app will be asked at every sign-in, on top of your password.
account_two_factor_scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or type the key by hand. Then give the code it shows.
account_backup_codes_body: Each code works once, when you do not have your app at hand. They will never be shown again.
account_backup_codes_saved: I have put my codes somewhere safe
account_backup_codes_low: Few are left: make new ones.
email_two_factor_recovery_started_intro: Someone who knows your password said they no longer have your authenticator app or your backup codes. Two-factor authentication will be turned off for your BattleCRM account on {date}.
email_two_factor_recovery_reminder_subje: Reminder: two-factor authentication will soon be turned off
email_two_factor_recovery_reminder_intro: A recovery is under way on your BattleCRM account: two-factor authentication will be turned off on {date}.
email_two_factor_recovery_not_me: If it was you, there is nothing to do. Otherwise, cancel the request, then choose a new password: someone knows yours.
email_two_factor_recovery_completed_subj: Recovery complete: two-factor authentication is off
email_two_factor_recovery_completed_intr: The 7 days of the recovery have passed: two-factor authentication was just turned off for your BattleCRM account. Your password alone signs you in again; you can turn it back on in Settings.
auth_recovery_lost: I can no longer get a code
auth_recovery_body: Without your authenticator app or a backup code, you can ask for two-factor authentication to be turned off. It takes effect after 7 days: an email warns you right away, and its link cancels the request.
auth_recovery_requested: Two-factor authentication will be turned off on {date}. Your password alone will then sign you in. An email was sent to you: its link cancels the request.
auth_recovery_cancelled_body: Two-factor authentication stays on for your account. If the request did not come from you, someone knows your password: choose a new one.
undo_too_late: This can no longer be undone.
undo_failed: Undo didn't work. Try again in a moment.
contacts_empty_body: Add someone to prospect: only a name is required.
contacts_load_error: Your Contacts could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
contact_stage_gone: This Stage is no longer in the Funnel: choose another one.
organization_type_required: Choose the type of this new Organization.
organization_taken: This Organization already exists: it is chosen instead, check then add.
no_organization_matches: No Organization matches: it will be created.
contact_linkedin_url_invalid: Enter the address of a LinkedIn profile, like linkedin.com/in/jane-doe.
contact_same_name: A Contact already has this name: {contact}
contact_same_name_in_organization: A Contact already has this name at {organization}
contact_same_phone: This phone number already belongs to {contact}
contact_unknown: This Contact does not exist, or no longer does.
contact_thread_load_error: The thread could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
contact_edit_changes_trial: The Trial in progress keeps its starting Target
organization_taken_on_edit: This Organization already exists: it is chosen instead, check then save.
organization_unknown: This Organization does not exist, or no longer does.
organization_name_taken: Another Organization already has this name.
organization_trials_keep_target: Trials already started keep their Target.
organization_changed_elsewhere: This Organization changed on another device: check, then try again.
organization_merge_choose: Choose the Organization to merge with.
next_action_archived: Nothing is final: you can bring them back.
change_status_behind: This Contact changed on another device: check, then try again.
change_status_trial_in_progress: {name} has a Trial in progress: settle it before leaving Prospecting.
settings_celebrate_goal_off: Without an Activity goal, there is nothing to celebrate.
settings_entry_goal_hint: The current week keeps its goal; it can be exceeded.
settings_check_in_rhythm_hint: “Check in soon” covers its last 7 days.
settings_default_cadence_hint: Fills in a new Positioning; changing it touches no existing Positioning.
settings_single_key_shortcuts_hint: N, /, ?, G + letter and V. Ctrl K and Esc always work.
settings_save_failed: Couldn't save. Try again in a moment.
follow_up_day_not_past: Pick a date, today or later.
follow_up_day_not_future: Pick a date, today or earlier.
follow_up_behind: This Contact changed on another device: check, then try again.
note_interaction_off_activity: Off the Activity: it does not count in the Activity of the day
note_interaction_inbound_hint: Did they write or call you?
positionings_intro: What you send at each Stage, and how you follow up. Modified copies show under their original.
positionings_empty: No Positioning for this Stage yet.
positionings_empty_hint: A Positioning is what you send at this Stage, and how you follow up.
positionings_no_stage: Your Funnel has no Stage: a Positioning belongs to a Stage.
positionings_choose: Pick a Positioning to see it.
positioning_frozen_reason: So that Battles compare what was really sent, its content, its cadence and its follow-up messages no longer change. To do otherwise, create a modified copy: a new Positioning, which can take this one on.
positioning_frozen_refused: This Positioning is frozen since its first Trial: create a modified copy.
positioning_editable: Not used yet: everything stays editable. It is frozen from its first Trial.
positioning_used_editable: Used outside a Battle: it stays editable, but can no longer be deleted. Archive it instead.
positioning_first_name_hint: replaced with the first name of the Contact when copied
positioning_prefilled_default: Filled in with your Default follow-up cadence (Settings).
positioning_response_window_hint: With no reply after the last follow-up, the Trial is flagged “window elapsed”.
positioning_counted_from: Each interval counts from your last outbound Interaction.
positioning_copy_note: The original stays as it is. This copy is a new Positioning: never used, editable until its first Trial.
positioning_freezes_note: Everything stays editable until its first Trial; then it is frozen (only a typo in the label can still be fixed).
positioning_relabel_hint: For a typo only: the new label shows everywhere, Trials and history included. To change what you send, create a modified copy instead.
positioning_archived_toast: “{label}” archived. It can come back as a Challenger.
positioning_behind: This Positioning changed on another device: check, then try again.
positioning_attachments_hint: Any type, 5 MB per file, 100 MB in all.
positioning_attachment_too_large: “{name}” is over 5 MB: it was not attached.
positioning_attachment_quota_exceeded: Your attachments would exceed 100 MB in all: remove one to make room.

match.countPlural=one: Its attachment comes along in the copy; you can remove it from its record.
match.countPlural=*: Its {count} attachments come along in the copy; you can remove them from its record.

positioning_attachments_after_creation: Attach files (a CV, say) from its record once it is created.
send_no_follow_up: No Follow-up: the Cadence of this Positioning has none
send_out_hint: Only a Contact Prospecting is in the Funnel and has a Follow-up cadence.
send_ally: Ally: the send is recorded without a Trial, its Days since contact start again from 0.
send_create_positioning: Create a Positioning for this Stage
send_toast: Sent to {name}: “{label}”, without a Trial. Follow-up 1 on {date}.
send_assigned_why: The Battle assigns at random so the comparison stays fair.
send_assignment_failed: The Assignment could not be made.
send_without_trial_already_tried: {name} already has a Trial in this Battle: no Assignment, free choice, without a Trial.
send_without_trial_off_target: Restricted Battle ({restriction}): {name} is not in its Target. Champion offered, without a Trial.
send_without_trial_horizon: Both Positionings reached the Horizon: Champion offered, without a Trial.
send_trial_elsewhere: {name} has a Trial in progress in another Battle: settle it first.
send_trial_started_override: Trial started, with an Override (your choice)
send_toast_trial: Sent to {name}: “{label}”, Trial started. Follow-up 1 on {date}.
send_bring_in_first: Open Battle at the Stage {stage}: bring {name} in to see the Positioning assigned at random.
send_assignment_required: A Battle opened at this Stage: see the Positioning assigned at random.
quick_add_send_hint: Ctrl Enter: add Prospecting and send a Positioning.
positioning_used_refused: This Positioning has been used already: archive it instead.
follow_up_no_message: No message for Follow-up {rank}: write your own.
reply_stops_cadence: The Cadence stops: the Follow-up on {date} stays scheduled, off cadence
battle_initial_champion_hint: The first Battle of this Stage: designate the Champion, usually what you already use.
battle_comes_back: archived, comes back as a Challenger
battle_needs_two: A Battle needs at least two Positionings at this Stage.
battle_criterion_hint: You will mark each success by hand against this criterion. It no longer changes once the Battle is open.
battle_fixed_note: Threshold and Horizon are fixed once open. The minimum ({finished} finished Trials per Positioning, {successes} successes) is not settable.
battle_recap: You will know whether {challenger} does better than {champion} for “{criterion}”{restriction}, drawn at random among the Contacts who reach “{stage}”: a Verdict is possible from {finished} finished Trials on each side and {successes} successes, at most {horizon} Trials per Positioning.
battle_recap_unknown: , with Contacts of unknown Target only
battle_already_open: This Stage already has an open Battle, opened on another device.
battle_behind: This Stage changed on another device: check, then try again.
battle_create_and_back: Create and go back to the Battle
positioning_archive_champion: Champion of its Stage: it is not archived. It loses its title when a Challenger beats it.
positioning_archive_in_battle: In an open Battle: it is not archived until the Battle is closed.
positioning_in_battle_kept: It served in a Battle: it can no longer be deleted. Archive it instead.
next_action_trial_waiting: Trial “{label}” in progress · window elapses on {date} without a reply
trial_cancel_reason_required: Say why the Trial is canceled.
trial_recap_success: Trial succeeded: one more data point for the Battle “{stage}”
trial_recap_no_result: Trial with no result: one more data point for the Battle “{stage}”
trial_recap_canceled: Trial canceled: it does not count in the Battle “{stage}”
trial_recap_in_progress: The Trial stays in progress: window elapses on {date} without a reply
trial_success_toast: Trial succeeded: one more data point for the Battle “{stage}” ({finished}/{started} finished).
trial_no_result_toast: Trial with no result: one more data point for the Battle “{stage}” ({finished}/{started} finished).
no_result_pool_question: Put {name} back in the Pool? They will come back among the Contacts suggested to bring in.
no_result_behind: The Trial changed on another device: check, then try again.
follow_up_anyway_recap: Off the Cadence: a deviation traced on the Trial
schedule_follow_up_deviation: Changing its day during a Trial: a deviation traced on the Trial

match.countPlural=one: No open Battle at {stage}: {count} Positioning available.
match.countPlural=*: No open Battle at {stage}: {count} Positionings available.

change_stage_no_positioning: No open Battle at {stage}, and no Positioning yet.
change_stage_behind: This Contact changed on another device: check, then try again.
last_stage_question: Success at the last Stage: add {name} to the Circle?
win_rule_conclusive: {winner} has a {percent}% chance of doing better than {loser}. The Battle is conclusive.
win_rule_in_progress: {leader} has a {percent}% chance of doing better than {other}. It takes {threshold}% to conclude.
win_rule_draw: Horizon reached without a winner: draw. {champion} keeps its title.
win_rule_not_enough_data: Horizon reached with too few successes: not enough data. {champion} keeps its title.
win_rule_too_early: Too early to conclude. {trend} Still missing: {missing}.
battle_indicative: indicative until the minimum is reached
battle_banner_horizon: No more assignments: the Battle awaits its closing.
battle_trials_editable: The outcome can be changed while the Battle is open.
battle_trials_load_error: The Trials could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
battle_cancel_trial_note: A canceled Trial does not count in the Battle.
battle_trial_closed: This Battle was closed in the meantime.
battle_trial_elsewhere: This Contact has a Trial in progress elsewhere: settle it first.
battle_trial_not_prospecting: This Contact is no longer Prospecting: its Trial cannot resume.
battle_trial_already_tried: This Contact already has another Trial in this Battle.
battle_trial_behind: This Trial changed on another device: check, then try again.
battle_by_target_note: For information only: the Verdict covers all Targets. Finished Trials only.
